description: Two young women walk through a dark haunted-house corridor at a funfair, hung with fake cobwebs and strings of coloured lights. They cling to each other with their eyes wide and their mouths open, edging forward. A masked figure in a white mask appears in the corridor behind them and they bolt, running towards the camera through a black curtain. They burst out into the daylight of the fairground, still gripping each other's hands, panting with their hands pressed to their chests.

en.question: How do the two women feel?

de.answer: Sie haben Angst vor dem Skelett.
